definition.def: If something frustrates you, it upsets or angers you because you are unable to do anything about the problems it creates.
examples: Doesn't it frustrate you that audiences in the theatre are so restricted? [VERB noun]

definition.def: If someone or something frustrates a plan or attempt to do something, they prevent it from succeeding.
examples: The government has frustrated his efforts to gain work permits for his foreign staff. [VERB noun]
Dave thumped the table in frustration.
She couldn't stand the frustration of not being able to help.

definition.def: something that causes you to feel frustrated
examples: Every job has its difficulties and frustrations.
She took out her frustrations on the children.
My biggest frustration was not having enough time.

definition.def: the fact that something is preventing something/somebody from succeeding
examples: the frustration of all his ambitions
